slides.title: Sunday Sports Schedule
slides.body: Golf, soccer, and MLB all day. Keep this post handy for start times and where to watch.

slides.title: Golf First
slides.body: FedEx St. Jude, Portland Classic, Danish GC, and Boeing Classic all tee off early. Watch on ESPN, ESPN+, CBS, and Golf Channel.

slides.title: Soccer Window
slides.body: Eredivisie, Championship, Primeira Liga, and La Liga matches run from early morning into the afternoon.

slides.title: MLB Midday
slides.body: Orioles-Rays on Peacock, plus Diamondbacks-Braves, Red Sox-Pirates, and Yankees-Blue Jays on MLB.TV.
